Ben L: Quick check 0AP-613 postmortem actions are overdue. Owners: @Tara N (schema migration rollback test), @Omar S (alerting gaps). Status?
Tara N: Blocked by missing rollback staging data. Filed DATA-101. Waiting on dataset snapshot.
Omar S: Working on alert runbook but need historical windows from Observability. Filed OBS-99. ETA depends on that.
remind-bot: Reminder: AP-613 overdue actions. Escalation scheduled in 48h.
Ben L: We need concrete ETAs today or I'll reassign. This is the second incident this quarter delayed by data/obs access.
Tara N: If DATA-101 isn't resolved by tomorrow noon I agree to reassign. ETA hopeful: snapshot by 2026-09-02 11:00 PT.
Omar S: OBS team replied, giving access by EOD. I'll validate alerts and update tracker by 16:00 PT.
Eng Director: Flagging a pattern at org level. Please add a preventive action to the postmortem: "verify access & dependency tickets created before owner assignment" and assign to Platform PM.
Tara N: Added the preventive action to the postmortem and linked DATA-101.
remind-bot: Closure verification scheduled for 2026-09-04 17:00 PT.
Omar S: Alerts validated, updated runbook and thresholds.
Tara N: Data snapshot delivered; rollback test passed in staging. Updated tracker.
Ben L: Thanks everyone 1 marking AP-613 verified. Platform PM, please track the preventive action follow-through.
